events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the influential American rapper and actor Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on this day in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, we lost guitar legend Jimi Hendrix. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His influence on music is immeasurable. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: That famous zebra crossing and those timeless tunes. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns another year older. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are as powerful as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Lennon's Vision
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this album mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years since the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic themes to unforgettable gadgets, which 007 film or song is your absolute favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us countless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Beatles
angles.copy: A kaleidoscope of sounds and styles! The Beatles' 'White Album' turns another year older. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Changing Sound
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released today. Which track from the album is on repeat for you?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon. His message of peace and love lives on through his timeless music.
